source_title: Guidelines for Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
issuing_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
notes: Authoritative operational guidelines governing selection based on 80th percentile of respective State/CBSE/ICSE boards and ₹4.5L family income cap.

source_title: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Caste Students (PMS-SC) Guidelines
issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India & Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
notes: Revised national operational framework for 2021-22 to 2025-26 governing 100% compulsory non-refundable fees concession and maintenance allowance with ₹2.5L parental income cap.

source_title: Guidelines for AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
issuing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
notes: Guidelines providing ₹50,000/annum for eligible female technical degree students admitted to AICTE approved institutions with family income <= ₹8,00,000.

source_title: Revised Operational Guidelines for Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
notes: Governs direct benefit transfer of ₹6,000/year to landholder farmer families across India subject to official Exclusion Criteria under Clause 5.

source_title: Government Order on Gruha Lakshmi Financial Assistance Scheme for Women Head of Household
issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
notes: Official Karnataka Gazette notification establishing monthly financial security of ₹2,000 to female heads of household (Yajamani) excluded from IT/GST.

source_title: Standard Operating Procedure for e-Attestation and Aadhaar DBT Seeding for Karnataka Post-Matric Students
issuing_authority: Centre for e-Governance & Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
notes: Mandates automated digital certificate validation via Nadakacheri RD numbers, e-Attestation by designated college nodal officers, and NPCI Aadhaar seeding.
